linear.value_proposition: Linear is a product development system for teams and agents, purpose-built for planning and building products in the AI era.
key_features: Issue tracking and management
AI-powered agents for workflow automation
Project planning and navigation
Code review and collaboration tools
Analytics and dashboards for progress tracking

notion.value_proposition: Notion provides a single platform where teams can do all their work, streamlining workflows and reducing timelines by 3x with the help of AI-powered agents.
notion.target_customer: Teams and enterprises, including Fortune 100 and YC companies
key_features: Custom Agents to automate repetitive work
AI-powered tools such as Q&A agents, task routing agents, and reporting agents
All-in-one workspace with features like docs, knowledge base, and project management

supabase.value_proposition: Supabase is the Postgres development platform that allows you to build, scale, and manage your projects with ease.
supabase.target_customer: Fast-growing companies and startups, as well as solo founders and developers
key_features: Postgres Database with built-in Auth and Row Level Security
Edge Functions for custom code without deploying or scaling servers
Realtime subscriptions for multiplayer experiences and real-time data synchronization

airtable.value_proposition: Airtable helps teams build AI-powered workflows that unify data, maximize collaboration, and set them up for long-term success without requiring code.
key_features: No-code components for building AI-powered workflows
Scalable infrastructure with HyperDB and support for tens of thousands of users
Flexible administration with admin roles, robust permissions, and fine-grained RBAC

vercel.value_proposition: Vercel provides the developer tools and cloud infrastructure to build, scale, and secure a faster, more personalized web.
key_features: AI Cloud infrastructure for building and deploying web applications
Fast load times and zero overhead with optimized infrastructure and CDN
Streamline content creation and publishing with built-in previews

figma.value_proposition: Figma is a collaborative design platform for designers and developers.
key_features: Collaborative design and development tools
AI-powered design and coding capabilities
Design systems and reusable components
